name_zh: 桑卡拉/布基纳法索/革命/反帝/妇女/自给/上沃尔特/托马斯
description_zh: 布基纳法索总统，反殖民主义革命者，女性解放倡导者，自给自足政策推动者，上沃尔特地区发展领导者
description_en: Burkina Faso president, anti-colonial revolutionary, women's liberation advocate, self-sufficiency policy promoter, Upland Volta region development leader
reason_zh: 托马斯·桑卡拉领导布基纳法索实行反殖民主义革命，推行自给自足政策，解放妇女地位，促进上沃尔特地区发展，建立独立自主的治理模式。
reason_en: Thomas Sankara led Burkina Faso's anti-colonial revolution, implemented self-sufficiency policies, liberated women's status, promoted Upland Volta region development, and established an independent governance model.
steps_zh: 推翻殖民主义统治，建立布基纳法索共和国
推行自给自足经济政策，减少对进口的依赖
解放妇女权利，赋予女性平等地位
开发上沃尔特地区基础设施和农业
建立大众教育体系，提高全民素质
steps_en: Overthrow colonial rule, establish Burkina Faso Republic
Implement self-sufficiency economic policies, reduce dependence on imports
Liberate women's rights, grant women equal status
Develop Upland Volta region infrastructure and agriculture
Establish mass education system, improve public quality
expected_zh: 布基纳法索实现独立自主，经济自给自足，妇女地位提高，上沃尔特地区发展繁荣
expected_en: Burkina Faso achieves independent self-sufficiency, economic self-sufficiency, women's status improves, Upland Volta region develops prosperous
case_zh: 1979年托马斯·桑卡拉领导布基纳法索革命，推翻了殖民主义统治，建立了独立国家，推行了自给自足政策和女性解放运动。
case_en: In 1979, Thomas Sankara led Burkina Faso's revolution, overthrowing colonial rule and establishing an independent state, implementing self-sufficiency policies and women's liberation movement.
intellectual_tradition_zh: 反殖民主义革命、女性解放、自给自足
cross_cultural_impact_zh: 为非洲反殖民主义革命提供榜样，自给自足政策影响其他发展中国家，女性解放运动启发全球妇女
cross_cultural_impact_en: Provide example for African anti-colonial revolution, self-sufficiency policies influence other developing countries, women's liberation movement inspire global women
